constraints.name: workspace_onboarding_channels_values
constraints.definition: CHECK (((channels <@ '["instagram", "tiktok", "facebook", "linkedin", "email", "website"]'::jsonb) AND (jsonb_array_length(channels) = ((((( CASE WHEN (channels ? 'instagram'::text) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN (channels ? 'tiktok'::text) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + CASE WHEN (channels ? 'facebook'::text) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + CASE WHEN (channels ? 'linkedin'::text) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + CASE WHEN (channels ? 'email'::text) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + CASE WHEN (channels ? 'website'::text) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))))

constraints.name: workspace_onboarding_completed_requires_answers
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status <> 'completed'::text) OR ((sector_key IS NOT NULL) AND (jsonb_array_length(channels) > 0))))

constraints.name: workspace_onboarding_profiles_brand_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (project_id, brand_id) REFERENCES brand_brains(project_id, brand_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: workspace_onboarding_profiles_project_tenant_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (project_id, tenant_id) REFERENCES projects(project_id, tenant_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: workspace_onboarding_profiles_updated_by_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (updated_by) REFERENCES customer_profiles(auth_user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
